audit_items.proof_trace: Full repay uses `ceil(obligation.debt)` which is >= actual_debt by definition, so the user never pays less than owed. Partial repay uses `unsafe_decrease(float::from(amount))`, which is safe because `ceil(debt) > amount` implies `debt > amount` (for integer amounts), preventing underflow. At the reserve level, `reserve.repay_amount` guards its subtraction with `if self.debt.lt(repay_amount)` before calling `self.debt.sub(repay_amount)`, preventing any u256 underflow.
